metadata.title: The dynamics of the globular cluster NGC3201 out to the Jacobi radius

notes: No eligible stars: the paper's "potential escapers" and "unbound stars" are described as energetically unbound from the globular cluster while still associated with it, not as unbound from the Milky Way (T:p2-b1; T:p7-b4). The paper also provides no individual stellar identifiers linking any such stars to a Galactic-unbound assessment.
